reviewHistory.summary: The approved plate contains strong molten colour but the runtime baseline is static: lava does not show directional travel and existing point lights do not illuminate the plate. Define a masked GPU flow/highlight layer plus bounded thermal light variation without changing the accepted representation.

Directional cliff and labyrinth lava now reads as restrained continuous motion; local heat bounce preserves basalt and route contrast, reduced motion freezes safely, and the pass stays inside the mobile draw-call gate.

The first v3 volume/rim experiment was stopped at 177 projected high-tier calls. The bounded correction retired those renderables, retained periodic multi-scale hot-core/cooling-edge flow, and moved thermal contact into existing tile materials. Final live high-tier evidence is 173 calls and 45k triangles with no pipe/spoke artifact.

The accepted Firebridges mission lacks a physical traversal climax. Replace it with the approved Iron Skiff escape, preserve legacy progress monotonically, make the Level-3 maze visibly navigable, and temporarily remap the footer to a forgiving steering/throttle controller without adding UI gameplay authority.

The final Level-3 labyrinth adds a summit launch davit, three readable junction gatehouses, a guided front lavafall escape channel, four-stage Iron Skiff construction, and an enlarged Expedition Ship cradle. The left/right/forward controller remains presentation-only, auto-forward prevents a post-commit failure loop, reduced motion extracts deterministically, and batching lowers the full medium scene from 180 to 172 calls.
